justification: Daily windows match the cohort grain. Detection within 2 windows is one missed daily job plus the next. Top-5 is a small analyst budget. A 0.60 baseline floor is 3/5 true endpoints in that budget. A +0.10 Isolation Forest lift is a material effect on multivariate templates the per-endpoint MAD/rarity baseline is designed to miss. Development seed 20260101 is held out; locked evaluation uses 20260904.
